settings.font.universal.tooltip: Loads a bundled merged font (DejaVuSans + the font below + GNU Unifont over the whole Unicode BMP) so text in any language renders everywhere. The font below is still merged in as the priority for its language. Building the full atlas is heavier, so this is off by default.
settings.font.custom_glyph_ranges.toolti: This is advance level feature. Do not modify this if you don't know what you are doing. Example usage:- If you have downloaded and pointed to the ArialUnicodeMS.ttf font, you can use 0x0020, 0xFFFF, 0x00 text in this field to load all of the font texture in ImGui. Note the 0x00 as the last item in the range.

settings.input.title: Input Config
settings.input.key_timeout.tooltip: When GameOverlay press a key in the game, the key has to go to the GGG server for it to work. This process takes time equal to your latency x 3. During this time GameOverlay might press that key again. Set the key timeout value to latency x 3 so this doesn't happen. e.g. for 30ms latency, set it to 90ms. Also, do not go below 60 (due to server ticks), no matter how good your latency is.

WARNING: There is no rate limiter in GameHelper, once V-Sync is off,
it's your responsibility to use external rate limiter e.g. NVIDIA Control Panel
-> Manage 3D Settings -> Set Max Framerate to what your monitor support.
settings.misc.process_all_renderable.too: WARNING: This will greatly reduce GH speed as well as increase crashes/glitches. Always keep it unchecked.
settings.misc.disable_debug_counters: Disable debug counters (do it on 6 man party + juiced maps only)
settings.misc.entity_max_degree.tooltip: This limits the entity reading algorithm to a set number of CPUs. Select -1 to disable this limit. Use Task Manager CPU usage stat + Misc Tools -> performance stats to figure out best FPS to CPU usage ratio.
settings.misc.entity_staleness.tooltip: These options help detect and fix stale entity data (e.g. NPCs that teleport but keep old position in memory).
settings.misc.enable_npc_cleanup.tooltip:
Include NPC entities in the removal logic when they go invalid.
Prevents stale NPC entities from lingering in the entity dictionary.
settings.misc.enable_stale_cleanup.toolt:
Remove any entity that stays invalid for many consecutive frames,
regardless of entity type. Catches NPCs and other entities that
the default cleanup misses.

settings.plugin.help.default: Use the tabs to choose a section. Scroll with the mouse wheel. Hover controls for details. Settings are saved when you close the menu.
settings.plugin.help.RitualWispAlert: Enable the circle, then adjust its radius and colours. The colour changes when your character enters its range.
settings.plugin.help.WorldDrawing: This module has no additional settings.
settings.plugin.help.Atlas2: Choose map search, appearance or route tools in the tabs. This alternative module has its own settings.
settings.plugin.help.PickupHelper: Select the categories and hotkey first. Hover the options to see their limits. Mouse movement keeps the existing safety stop.
settings.plugin.help.PreloadAlert: Choose the alerts to display and their colours. Edit the list in the dedicated tab.
settings.plugin.help.Radar: Choose the objects to mark, then adjust icons and distances. Appearance settings only change the overlay.
settings.plugin.help.AutoHotKeyTrigger: Choose a profile and create rules with conditions. A rule uses the key and conditions you configure; check each condition before enabling it.
settings.plugin.help.HealthBars: Choose the player or monster tab, then set the bars, colours and size for that category.
settings.plugin.help.Atlas: Search for maps, choose the map information to display, then configure route tools in their tab.
settings.plugin.help.RitualHelper: Set the reward display and pricing options. Values depend on the selected source and league.
settings.plugin.help.Autopot: Set each flask key and threshold. Emergency logout has separate settings in Protection and can remain active when automatic flasks are disabled.
settings.plugin.help.SekhemaHelper: Configure the route and overlay first. Diagnostics contain advanced tools and are optional.
settings.plugin.help.AuraTracker: Set the tracking range and filters, then adjust the list and colours. Aura filters match the displayed labels.
settings.plugin.help.AmanamuVoidAlert: Choose the tracking and notification options, then set their appearance.
settings.plugin.help.PlayerBuffBar: Choose which effects and summons to show. Each bar has its own size, position and filter settings.
settings.plugin.help.SimpleBars: Use the player or monster tabs to preview each bar. Disable the other health-bar module to avoid overlapping displays.
settings.plugin.help.Hiveblood: Visit the Genesis Tree once to synchronise the amount. Then choose visibility, cap warning and overlay position.
settings.plugin.help.LootTracker: Choose the pricing league and source, then the tracking display. Map totals include their recorded subareas.
settings.plugin.help.RunecraftHelper: Choose the pricing and route options first. Diagnostics and calibration are grouped separately. Mouse movement keeps the existing safety stop.
settings.plugin.help.LootValue: Choose the pricing source and league, then the item panels on which values should appear.
settings.plugin.help.StashUtility: Use the tabs for storage, inventory, filters and display. Tablet Catalogue shows the exact S to F workbook ranks; Rules controls the active AND/OR profile.
settings.plugin.help.StashValueByZx0: Select the league and pricing source, then enable the stash or inventory display and adjust its minimum value.
settings.plugin.help.CameraZoom: Adjust the camera settings in their dedicated section. Hover options for their explanation.
settings.plugin.help.KikiMeter: Enable the panel and choose whether it appears on the game or in a separate window. Live, Compare, History and Maps organise the measurements.
settings.plugin.help.CorpseCleaner: Corpses, camera distance and map borders, even without ExileCenter. Apply and restore with the game closed.
ui.labels.draw_connected_node_and_badge_: Draw connected-node and badge counts under each map label on the Atlas.
ui.labels.draw_the_node_s_content_under_: Draw the node's content under each map label, using the known names.
ui.labels.also_show_unmapped_content_as_: Also show unmapped content as its raw 0x value (for identifying new content).
ui.labels.highlights_the_atlas_nodes_and: Highlights the atlas nodes and connections revealed by the hovered Uncharted Waters ship.
ui.labels.marks_uncharted_waters_ships_t: Marks Uncharted Waters ships that the game is not currently rendering.
ui.labels.predicts_the_deterministic_rit: Predicts the deterministic Rite modifiers for eligible Ritual-line routes.
ui.labels.lists_and_highlights_ritual_ro: Lists and highlights Ritual routes and their predicted rewards while line mode is active.
ui.labels.maximum_path_length_in_maps_to: Maximum path length in maps to clear.
ui.labels.node_text_color_the_path_autom: Node-text color. The path automatically uses the more colorful of the text and background colors.
ui.labels.node_background_color_the_path: Node background color. The path automatically uses the more colorful of the text and background colors.
ui.labels.note_for_going_above_below_the: NOTE: For going above/below the limit, or for manual editing, press CTRL + Left Mouse Button click.
ui.labels.graduation_thickness_depends_o: Graduation thickness depends on Font size. Also, Gradation marks are expensive to draw.
ui.labels.turn_off_in_game_health_bars_f: Turn off in game health bars for best result.
ui.labels.disable_the_built_in_healthbar: Disable the built-in HealthBars plugin when using SimpleBars.
ui.labels.draw_healthbars_when_game_is_i: Draw healthbars when game is in background
ui.labels.enable_this_if_your_healthbar_: Enable this if your healthbar is stuttering.
ui.labels.tracks_hiveblood_syncs_from_ge: Tracks Hiveblood: syncs from Genesis Tree (+ Breach popups). Visit the tree once to calibrate.
ui.labels.also_show_when_inventory_is_cl: Also show when inventory is closed
ui.labels.above_the_threshold_the_overla: Above the threshold the overlay text turns orange-red and blinks. It is also shown while the inventory is closed (at the last in-inventory position).
ui.labels.show_gains_since_last_tree_syn: Show gains since last tree sync
ui.labels.bottom_anchor_left_edge_of_the: Bottom anchor: left edge of the inventory panel, just above the gold line. Drag X/Y to fine-tune.
ui.labels.shows_a_draggable_preview_in_g: Shows a draggable preview in-game and saves a fixed screen position. Switches to custom screen position.
ui.labels.how_often_the_plugin_reads_the: How often the plugin reads the game UI tree. Lower values react faster but use more CPU (default 300).
ui.labels.comma_space_separated_crystal_: Comma/space separated crystal entity ids (read from the yellow/grey id labels). Empty = normal room route.
ui.labels.paint_walkable_grid_where_can_: Paint Walkable Grid (where can I walk)
ui.labels.green_cells_the_game_marks_wal: Green = cells the game marks walkable, around the player. Shows why an A* leg goes straight (player on a non-walkable cell).
ui.labels.draw_floor_plots_all_rooms_on_: Draw floor plots (all rooms on large map)
ui.labels.reads_the_client_s_terrain_lay: Reads the client's terrain layout: every room's type+reward at its world position, incl. rooms the UI hides. Open the large map to see it.
ui.labels.tune_until_the_red_footprint_c: Tune until the red footprint covers the blocker (re-floods live).
ui.labels.charges_s_p_c_straight_a_path_: charges: S/P/C = straight / A* path / A* raw-cost, from the PREVIOUS chain node
ui.labels.no_monoliths_detected_in_this_: No monoliths detected in this area.
ui.labels.resources_unavailable_enter_a_: Resources unavailable: enter a game area to read them.
ui.labels.choose_the_resources_to_monito: Choose the resources to monitor. Each flask uses its own key and delay.
ui.labels.also_use_flasks_in_the_hideout: Also use flasks in the hideout
ui.labels.emergency_logout_is_configured: Emergency logout is configured separately in Protection.
ui.labels.disconnects_when_an_enabled_re: Disconnects when an enabled resource reaches its threshold. This protection also works when automatic flasks are disabled.
ui.labels.after_logout_select_your_chara: After logout, select your character and use Return to hideout in the AutoPot panel. The button uses Ctrl + click on Play. If no hideout is available, the game returns you to town.
ui.labels.returning_to_the_map_is_interr: Returning to the map is interrupted while the hideout return is pending.
ui.labels.at_character_selection_place_t: At character selection, place the pointer in the centre of Play and press F8. This setup does not click or connect.
ui.labels.prevents_repeated_logouts_when: Prevents repeated logouts when you reconnect with a resource still below its threshold.
ui.labels.in_controller_mode_enable_the_: In controller mode, enable the virtual controller to send flask buttons.
ui.labels.send_flasks_through_the_virtua: Send flasks through the virtual controller
ui.labels.choose_your_character_a_normal: Choose your character. A normal click on Play may return you to the map.
ui.labels.place_the_pointer_in_the_centr: Place the pointer in the centre of Play, then press F8 to save its position.
ui.labels.you_can_also_hold_ctrl_and_cli: You can also hold Ctrl and click Play yourself.
ui.labels.waiting_for_your_character_in_: Waiting for your character in a game area.
ui.labels.flasks_follow_the_configured_t: Flasks follow the configured thresholds and keys.
ui.labels.you_are_in_a_safe_area: You are in a safe area.
ui.labels.flasks_are_paused_in_the_hideo: Flasks are paused in the hideout.
ui.labels.you_can_search_multiple_maps_a: You can search multiple maps at once using a comma separator ','
ui.labels.by_default_texture_is_of_heigh: By default texture is of height 16, If increasing the Y axis ruins the texture, feel free to modify the texture height via your fav texture editor. This doesn't apply to x axis.
ui.labels.creates_a_virtual_xbox_360_con:
Creates a virtual Xbox 360 controller via ViGEmBus and injects button presses
instead of keyboard events. Required when PoE2 is in controller mode.
ViGEmBus driver must be installed.
ui.labels.inventory_top_left_inventory_b: Inventory top-left�Inventory bottom (near gold)�Custom screen position�
ui.labels.drag_to_move_disable_dummy_in_: Drag to move. Disable dummy in settings when done.
ui.labels.an_8_hole_monolith_is_nearby_o:
An 8+ hole monolith is nearby. Open its Runeshape Combinations panel
first, then press this: with the panel open, the report can compare
the game's own recipe list against ours.
ui.labels.collect_ground_truth_to_revers:
Collect ground-truth to reverse the server's (layer,room)->physical-room assignment. Keep the Trial map OPEN when pressing these.
1) enter a fresh floor -> New floor snapshot
2) in each room you visit -> Record current room
3) at floor end -> Save floor
Repeat for 8-15 floors; data lands in config\sekhema_research\dataset.jsonl.
